jobs.description:
About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The brain

The agents are the arms. The next layer is a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers: conversations on chat, email, phone and social, on-site behaviour, orders, returns and reviews.

The system identifies the moments where a sale is won or lost and intervenes while the session is still live. It scores answer coverage per product and closes the gaps, quantifies objections and unmet demand, and traces returns back to the expectation that broke.

Learning happens across all webshops, more than six million visits a month, where patterns become visible that no single shop has the traffic to see. Every intervention is measured against a control group. The patterns are shared, the data stays with each shop.

The hard problems are retrieval and evaluation of LLM output at scale, data isolation when patterns are shared across customers, latency in real-time flows, and attribution that holds up under scrutiny.

The stack

Java with Spring Boot, React and MongoDB, with language models and vector search on top. Moving the backend to C# and .NET is under consideration.

The role

Technical ownership of the platform: architecture, code quality, operations, security and prioritisation, combined with hands-on development every day. Standards for review, testing, monitoring and releases, and recruiting the next developers.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished tech organisation with fixed processes. The standards for review, testing, operations and releases, and the developers you hire, become the foundation the platform and the team grow on.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

Profile

• 
Several years of designing and running SaaS systems in production, with ownership of architecture and uptime

• 
Solid backend experience in Java or C#, plus React

• 
LLM-based features shipped to production, with systematic evaluation and improvement

• 
Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and incident handling

• 
AI-assisted development as part of the daily workflow

The person

• 
Dreams of owning and building a company

• 
Ideally has tried starting something and knows what it takes

• 
Thinks like a founder, not an employee

• 
Happily gives more than a regular job asks for, because it is fun

• 
Says things as they are, and can take the same in return

• 
Takes ownership and looks for solutions rather than excuses

• 
Curious, learns fast and has a positive mindset

What we offer

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Equity

• 
Short decision paths and a high degree of technical freedom

• 
Office at Storms Pakhus in Odense

Application process

We take the time it takes to find the right match.

• 
Introductory conversation

• 
Technical test

• 
Conversation about expectations and terms

Send a short description of a system you have owned in production, and an architectural decision you would make differently today, to jobs@userlink.ai.

You combine a strong commercial mindset with an analytical and structured approach. jobs.occupation: Project Planning Specialist, Medium Voltage Products
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Product Marketing Manager

__

**What we believe in:

**At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

**Role and tasks

**As Project Planning Specialist, you will combine project planning and control with operational sales administration support within ABB’s Medium Voltage Products business. Working closely with project managers and colleagues across sales administration, engineering, finance, procurement and operations, you will create reliable schedules, maintain accurate SAP data and provide clear insights into project costs, revenue, cash flow, risks and opportunities.

The role is designed with a broad scope. Alongside project planning responsibilities, you will support the sales administration team during peak workload periods and planned absences and help administer project-related financial guarantees. Your work will contribute to reliable project delivery, accurate commercial data and continuity in day-to-day operations. The position is based at our office in Middelfart and follows a hybrid work model.

• Maintaining and improving SAP master data, including material creation, sales item maintenance, product group structures and customer segmentation.

• Developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, including baselines, forecasts, milestones, resources and critical-path activities.

• Monitoring project progress, costs, revenue and cash flow, and providing regular reports and forecasts to the project team and relevant stakeholders.

• Identifying scheduling or cost deviations and working with project managers to define practical corrective actions.

• Creating, administering and maintaining advance payment guarantees, warranty guarantees and other project-related financial securities.

• Providing operational support and backup during peak workload periods and planned absences within the sales administration team.

• Supporting project risk, change, contract and claims management by assessing potential schedule and cost impacts and contributing to mitigation plans.

• Coordinating planning activities with engineering, procurement, finance, customers, contractors and other stakeholders while contributing to improvements in local tools and processes.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• Hands-on experience using SAP for master data maintenance, material creation, sales item maintenance or related sales administration tasks.

Are you ready to lead a skilled laboratory team on an exciting change journey? Do you want to drive lager projects and digitalization to shape the laboratory of the future at one of Denmark’s largest dairies? If you are passionate about continuous improvement and want to make a real impact, keep reading to discover your next career opportunity at Esbjerg Dairy Center.

“As our new Laboratory Teamlead, you will be at the forefront of modernizing our laboratory, supporting both people and processes on our journey towards increased digitalization and automation. You’ll play a key role in taking our quality standards to the next level,” says Anne Sofie Huusmann Jepsen, Senior QEHS Manager.

How you will make an impact

As Laboratory Teamlead, you will manage and develop a larger team of lab technicians, specialists, and part-time employees at our Esbjerg Dairy Center. You’ll not only ensure the daily operations and compliance but will also lead the team through a significant transformation - embracing new digital tools and automating processes to enhance efficiency and quality.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Daily management and development of a larger laboratory team

• Drive lager projects and leading the laboratory’s change journey with a strong focus on increased digitalization and automation

• Deviation handling and release of finished goods

• Ensuring optimal and rational operation of the laboratory, including coordination of external analyses

• Collaborating with the QEHS Manager and Team to ensure quality-assured product release in accordance with regulations

• Handling and processing customer complaints in cooperation with QEHS colleagues and lab specialists

What will make you successful

We are looking for a forward-thinking professional with leadership experience and a passion for leading teams through change. Your ability to engage and inspire others will be crucial as you help bring digital transformation and automation to life.

Furthermore you bring

• 
A track record of driving change, especially within digitalization or automation projects

• 
Ability to motivate people and foster a growth mindset

• 
Basic proficiency in Danish and English

• 
Laboratory experience, ideally including microbiology, is an advantage.

You stand out for your strong organizational skills and your ability to approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset. Your excellent interpersonal skills, combined with a proactive attitude, enable you to engage effectively with your team and drive positive change throughout the laboratory.

What do we offer?

You will join a passionate team at Esbjerg Dairy Center, where collaboration and a willingness to embrace new ways of working are key. At Arla, we are committed to professional development and promoting from within. You’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful change and bring out the best in yourself and your colleagues, as part of a market leader producing nutritious household-favorite brands.
